title: Lov om ansættelsesbeviser og visse arbejdsvilkår §§ 3, 4 and 6: the ansættelsesbevis
source: Lov nr. 501 af 16. maj 2023 om ansættelsesbeviser og visse arbejdsvilkår, Lovtidende A 2023, in force 1 July 2023. Read on retsinformation.dk 2026-10-09.
note: A drafting check, not legal advice: the scripted rules read whether a particular is there, never whether a term is lawful.

rules.text: Items 1 to 5, 7 and 10 to 12 reach the employee in writing within seven calendar days of the start; the rest within a month.
The names and addresses of both parties, the place of work, the work or title, the start and an expected length when it is not open-ended.
The user undertaking of an agency worker, the probation's length and terms, paid leave and the notice periods.
The pay at the start with supplements (pension, board and lodging) and the pay intervals.
The normal daily or weekly hours, overtime and its pay, shift changes; for an unpredictable pattern the guaranteed hours, reference hours and days and minimum notice.
Training the employer offers, the collective agreements and who made them, and the social security institutions the employer pays.
Items 1 to 6, 12 and 14 are stated; the others may point to laws or agreements.
Work abroad for more than four consecutive weeks: the countries and length, the currency, the benefits, the journey home and whether the certificates are arranged, before departure.
A probation of at most six months, and in a fixed term at most a quarter of it.
The statement is written in Danish throughout, headings included.
rules.source: house rule for a Danish document
